title: Mixed total tensor preserves K-flat quasi-isomorphisms

from.place: proof of Tag 0DJ8: choose K-flat models for the derived tensor over R; Tag 06Y6 construction of the fixed-second-factor derived tensor

statement: Let $R$ and $A$ be commutative rings and $f:R\to A$ a ring homomorphism. Let $B(E,N)=\operatorname{Tot}(E\otimes_R N)$, with $E$ an unbounded cochain complex of $R$-modules and $N$ an unbounded cochain complex of $A$-modules; this is the mixed total tensor [def-pc-mixed-total-tensor], with its $A$-action through $N$. Use ordinary-module K-flatness [def-pc-module-kflat-complex] and quasi-isomorphisms [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. (i) For every $N$, a quasi-isomorphism $a:E\to E'$ between K-flat $R$-complexes induces a quasi-isomorphism $B(a,1_N)$. (ii) For every quasi-isomorphism $u:N\to N'$ and every K-flat $R$-complex $F$, the map $B(1_F,u)$ is a quasi-isomorphism of $A$-complexes.

proof.text: Restrict the A-complexes to R. The tensor associativity map identifies the restriction of N tensor_A (A tensor_R E) with N tensor_R E. On the total complexes use the signed swap x tensor y ↦ (-1)^(pq) y tensor x to put E first. It commutes with both differentials and variable maps. Restriction is exact and reflects isomorphisms, so it detects quasi-isomorphisms.

For (i), take a K-flat resolution K → N of the restricted complex, using lem-pc-kflat-resolution on the one-point site and the ordinary-module interpretation. Form the natural tensor square with rows a tensor 1_K and a tensor 1_N. K-flatness of K makes the top map a quasi-isomorphism; K-flatness of E and E prime makes the two vertical maps quasi-isomorphisms. Functoriality and two-of-three imply the bottom map is a quasi-isomorphism. Equivalently apply lem-pc-kflat-tensor-quasi-iso after the ordinary-module comparison.

For (ii), restriction of u is a quasi-isomorphism. Ordinary-module K-flatness of F says exactly that tensoring this map with F on either side is a quasi-isomorphism. Apply the natural signed tensor comparison of the first step and detection by restriction.

lean.statement: theorem mixedTensor_kFlat_quasiIso {R A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] (f : R →+* A) : let B := (ModuleCat.mixedTensor f).flip.map₂CochainComplex (∀ (N : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (E E' : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) (a : E ⟶ E'), QuasiIso a → (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat R) (.up ℤ)).kFlat E → (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat R) (.up ℤ)).kFlat E' → QuasiIso ((B.map a).app N)) ∧ (∀ (N N' : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (u : N ⟶ N'), QuasiIso u → ∀ F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ, (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat R) (.up ℤ)).kFlat F → QuasiIso ((B.obj F).map u))
